rapport_notes: Checked in proactively on pacing/clarity and patiently captured a long, scattered inventory list.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general?" (asked late; prompted an added-item disclosure, not a true concern)
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep followed up with 'will that be all?' twice to make sure the full inventory was captured, continuing until the customer confirmed.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if we end quicker than my estimate then we'll just be charging you for the total time consumed" — conveys the pay-less-if-faster idea, though not the specific 15-minute-increment framing

top_strength: Checked in proactively ('does everything make sense so far, or do I speak too fast?') and patiently captured a long, scattered inventory list across multiple follow-ups without losing track of any item.
coaching_note: None of the other four Save Your Ass lines (rate commitment, estimate-is-a-window framing, self-prep tip) were delivered, and the agenda question came after most of the logistics probing rather than before it.
